The '''TT-17A Hydra''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that was vastly popular with both [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] alike during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. With notable users of the set being [[Tarro Blood]] and the famed Mandalorian bounty hunter [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], the TT-17A Hydra unlike of the traditional T visor common in other sets of Mandalorian armor, the Hydra uses a X visor instead.
